name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 48 - Am 86
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 48b. Firmly believes that the financialisation and speculative investment in student housing must be eradicated by ensuring public or non-profit ownership requirements, guaranteeing that student accommodation remain permanently decent, sustainable and affordable for students;
